cases.question: Mina has 12 coins and receives 5 more coins. How many coins does she have now?
Luc had 19 stickers and gave away 7 stickers. How many stickers remain?
A shelf holds 4 trays with 6 cups on each tray. How many cups are on the shelf?
A gardener plants 3 rows of 8 trees each and later removes 5 trees. How many trees remain?
A baker prepares 48 muffins, sells one quarter of them, then gives 6 away. How many muffins are left?
A ticket office sells 9 tickets in the morning and twice as many in the afternoon, then cancels 4 tickets. How many tickets remain sold?
